evals.prompt: Create our first shared composite action for the org.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds .github/actions/<name>/action.yml with a kebab-case directory and name, mandatory description, kebab-case inputs/outputs, and shell: on every run step. Adds a same-repo consumer workflow (uses: ./) to test it, and picks a distribution topology.

evals.prompt: Set up versioning and release automation for our reusable workflows.
evals.expected_output: Wires release-please or semantic-release to produce vX.Y.Z tags plus a force-pushed floating major, documents the workflow_call contract and compatibility rules, and describes testing before tagging via a consumer repo. Notes that GITHUB_TOKEN-created tags do not retrigger workflows.
